job.code: CREATE TABLE x(a,b);INSERT INTO x VALUES (NULL,'v'),(NULL,'v'),(2,'w');

checks.label: Exact repeated NULL tuples
checks.expression: WITH expected("a","b") AS (VALUES (NULL,'v'),(NULL,'v'),(2,'w')), actual AS (SELECT "a","b",COUNT(*) AS multiplicity FROM "x" GROUP BY "a","b"), wanted AS (SELECT "a","b",COUNT(*) AS multiplicity FROM expected GROUP BY "a","b") SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM actual EXCEPT SELECT * FROM wanted) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM wanted EXCEPT SELECT * FROM actual)

columns: NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM actual EXCEPT SELECT * FROM wanted) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM wanted EXCEPT SELECT * FROM actual)
